features.name: continue keyword in AL
features.description: New continue keyword added to AL language for use in loops (for, while, repeat). Allows skipping the current iteration and moving to the next iteration without terminating the loop.
caveats: Code can be restructured to avoid using continue
continue is optional - not a breaking change

quotes.text: we need to distinguish between what break does and what continue does.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the foundational difference between two loop control keywords

quotes.text: we test if the number is an even number and if it's an even number we skip it
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the primary use case of continue - filtering out records without restructuring code

quotes.text: continue which means don't get here but rather here at the end and increment i to three
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how continue transfers control flow to the loop increment rather than executing the rest of the iteration body

quotes.text: instead of spending the time to refactor all this function
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the practical value proposition - reduces refactoring work in existing code
